game.name: Ihf Handball Challenge 14 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,Sv,Da)
game.desc: IHF Handball Challenge 14 is a handball sports game and the second in the series as the follow-up to IHF Handball Challenge 12. As a licensed game it offers 80 clubs for the 2013-2014 season for the leagues Ligue Nationale de Handball (France), DKB Handball-Bundesliga (Germany) and Liga ASOBAL (Spain), as well as 30 national teams, and live commentary in three languages (German, French and English). Players can also create their own leagues, players, and teams, and build a career for an entirely new player. It is possible to design custom tournaments and player with up to four players simultaneously.
